comparison_assessments.accuracy_note: Preserves the plea not to remember youthful sins or rebellions, followed by the request to remember the speaker in faithful love and the closing appeal to Yahweh’s goodness.
comparison_assessments.creative_liberties_note: “The ways I've rebelled” expresses “my transgressions” as actions. “With your faithful love” slightly loosens “according to your loyal love,” and “because you're good” recasts an appeal for goodness’ sake as a statement of God’s character.
